title: SynAmp business and development roadmap
capacity: 20–25 owner hours/week · one-time purchase · optional cloud later

scenarios.label: Working plan · Dec 1
scenarios.detail: Limited paid early access · all gates required · broader promotion after seven stable days

scenarios.label: Stretch · Nov 24
scenarios.detail: Same gates · about 20.4 pre-release hours/week · small invited cohort before Thanksgiving

scenarios.label: Fallback · Dec 15
scenarios.detail: Extra stabilization time · if gates remain open, move release to January

tasks.label: Measure → repair → ten-library proof
tasks.detail: 12 frozen requests; two raters per library; measured coverage and strict shortages; ≥80% useful supported pairs; no observed hard-rule violation.

tasks.label: Workday listening and variety
tasks.detail: Check continuous mixes, corrections, repeat cycling and restart on actual libraries; measure mature cohort return.

tasks.label: Spike → guided first listen
tasks.detail: One supported server/Mac combination, small-library first value, honest analysis wait, resumable setup.

tasks.label: Cold installs · restore · updates
tasks.detail: ≥9/10 unassisted installs including ≥5 non-friends; preserve every failed attempt; test backup/restore and upgrade/data rollback.

tasks.label: Candidate and lifecycle support
tasks.detail: Versioned releases and running build identity; actual native-client/cellular/locked-phone evidence; storage migration if bounded file stores fail.

tasks.label: Fix known failure · required checks
tasks.detail: Root-cause capitalization failure on case-insensitive filesystem; CI based on current scripts; no pass wrapper; real critical browser flows.

tasks.label: Freeze scope · close blockers
tasks.detail: No open supported-path release-blocking S1/S2; single writer, interrupted-state recovery, private access and bounded storage proven.

tasks.label: Five → ten supported testers
tasks.detail: Wave 1; activation ≥6/10 completed installs aged 72h; blockers <20%; five interviews; install failures retained in separate funnel.

tasks.label: Five-person waves · mature W4
tasks.detail: May start Oct 28 only if G2 passes early; ≤15 active testers. Nov 24 requires ten activations by Oct 27; Dec 1 requires ten by Nov 3. W4 ≥50% with n≥10 mature; missing replies remain unknown.

tasks.label: Claims · consent · real-build clips
tasks.detail: Collector/NAS audience; proposed all-surface copy sweep; keep launch-only email promise; two actual-build clips and overview; no fake DJ or mood claim.

tasks.label: Two small channel batches
tasks.detail: Broad publicity only after G5; moments ≥3 days apart; ≥3 activated households in each batch; pause above 5 support hours/week.

tasks.label: Name · licenses · external services
tasks.detail: Per-artifact rights decisions; preserve upstream notices; Last.fm commercial position, lyrics/AcoustID and name review; unresolved services excluded or release blocked.

tasks.label: Offer test → sandbox checkout
tasks.detail: Proposed $39 launch/$49 standard Home convenience and bounded support; MIT source available; purchase/refund/fulfillment checks; future cloud not offered.

tasks.label: Paid cohort → January review
tasks.detail: Target ≥10 real paid customers; one-time sales separate from MRR; actual support cost and mature conversion; bottom-up market memo.

gates.label: Baseline
gates.detail: Supported scope and first listening path; quality/throughput baseline; external dependencies inventoried.

gates.label: Safe beta
gates.detail: Trial copy or verified backup; optional small reviewed write/undo; five attempts recorded.

gates.label: Cold installs
gates.detail: ≥9/10 unassisted successes; ≥5 non-friends; ten real-library reviews; supported path verified.

gates.label: Paid EA
gates.detail: All quality/install/safety/rights/checkout gates; W4 ≥50% with ≥10 mature users; no open release-blocking S1/S2. Target follows selected scenario.

gates.label: Widen carefully
gates.detail: At least seven stable days after actual release, manageable support, small channel evidence and a try-without-signup path.

gates.label: Review
gates.detail: 25–40 cumulative testers; 100 qualified waitlist; activation ≥60%; W4 ≥50%; ≥10 paying; repeated channel; support ≤5h/week.
